ranked_clusters.selection_case: This is a top-tier macroeconomic indicator that directly influences Federal Reserve policy and global markets. The immediate drop in rate hike probabilities to 31% provides a strong, actionable angle for investors.

ranked_clusters.visual_strategy: Line chart showing the trajectory of US headline and core CPI over the past five years, alongside a bar chart of current Fed rate hike probabilities.
ranked_clusters.why_now: US inflation data for July has just been released, showing a drop to 3.4% and core inflation hitting a five-year low, immediately impacting rate hike probabilities and SOFR arbitrage.

ranked_clusters.visual_strategy: Map of the Strait of Hormuz highlighting shipping lanes and current naval deployments or blockages.
ranked_clusters.why_now: Iran has explicitly rejected US claims of control over the Strait of Hormuz, stating the critical waterway remains blocked amid ongoing diplomatic tensions.
